description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractModifyLiveCommand' that serves as a base implementation for live command classes wrapping 'ThingModifyCommand' objects. It provides methods to access the associated Thing ID and entity data in JSON format, and it extends 'AbstractLiveCommand' while implementing 'ThingModifyCommand'.

classes.name: AbstractModifyLiveCommand
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for live commands that modify Things, encapsulating a 'ThingModifyCommand' instance and exposing key methods.

methods.name: AbstractModifyLiveCommand
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command with a 'ThingModifyCommand' to wrap.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing entity this command targets.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON entity data associated with the command, parameterized by schema version.
